items.title: Dupilumab in persistent asthma with elevated eosinophil levels.
items.journal: The New England journal of medicine
items.summary: Dupilumab showed efficacy in persistent asthma with elevated eosinophil levels in this randomized controlled trial.

items.title: Mometasone or Tiotropium in Mild Asthma with a Low Sputum Eosinophil Level.
items.journal: The New England journal of medicine
items.summary: Crossover trial comparing mometasone and tiotropium in mild asthma patients with low sputum eosinophil levels.

items.title: Role of nebulised magnesium sulfate in treating acute asthma in children: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: Meta-analysis of 10 RCTs found nebulized magnesium sulfate ineffective as second-line treatment for acute asthma in children.

items.title: Randomized pilot trial of ipratropium versus placebo in children with critical asthma.
items.summary: Randomized pilot trial found no benefit of ipratropium versus placebo in children with critical asthma.

items.title: Randomized placebo-controlled trial to evaluate chronic dosing effects of propranolol in asthma.
items.journal: American journal of respiratory and critical care medicine
items.summary: Double-blind crossover trial found propranolol ineffective as add-on therapy to inhaled corticosteroids in mild-to-moderate asthma.

items.title: Reslizumab for inadequately controlled asthma with elevated blood eosinophil counts: results from two multicentre, parallel, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trials.
items.summary: Two phase 3 trials demonstrated efficacy of reslizumab in inadequately controlled asthma with elevated blood eosinophil counts.

items.title: Breastfeeding in the 21st century: epidemiology, mechanisms, and lifelong effect.
items.summary: Meta-analysis found no association between breastfeeding and allergic disorders such as asthma.

items.title: Inner-City Asthma in Children.
items.summary: Review of inner-city asthma in children highlighting increased morbidity and contributing factors.

items.title: Global, regional, and national deaths, prevalence, disability-adjusted life years, and years lived with disability for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and asthma, 1990-2015: a systematic analysis for the Global Burden of Disease Study 2015.
items.summary: Global Burden of Disease study analysis of COPD and asthma deaths, prevalence, and disability-adjusted life years from 1990-2015.

items.title: Allergen Immunotherapy for the Prevention and Treatment of Asthma.
items.journal: Clinical and experimental allergy : journal of the British Society for Allergy and Clinical Immunology
items.summary: Review of allergen immunotherapy as disease-modifying treatment for allergic asthma prevention and management.

items.title: Asthma: definitions and pathophysiology.
items.summary: Review of asthma definitions and pathophysiology, emphasizing chronic lower respiratory tract inflammation.

items.title: Understanding the immunology of asthma: Pathophysiology, biomarkers, and treatments for asthma endotypes.
items.summary: Comprehensive review of asthma immunology, pathophysiology, biomarkers, and targeted biologic therapies for different endotypes.

items.title: The Effect of Oral Montelukast in Controlling Asthma Attacks in Children: A Randomized Double-blind Placebo Control Study.
items.journal: Iranian journal of allergy, asthma, and immunology

items.title: Synbiotics and Treatment of Asthma: A Double-Blinded, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Clinical Trial.

canonicalFacts.claim: Asthma is a heterogeneous disease characterized by chronic inflammation of the lower respiratory tract
Dupilumab is effective in persistent asthma with elevated eosinophil levels
Reslizumab is effective for inadequately controlled asthma with elevated blood eosinophil counts
Inner-city children have increased asthma morbidity due to multiple environmental and socioeconomic factors

redFlags: Leukotriene receptor antagonists may unmask Churg-Strauss syndrome as oral glucocorticoids are withdrawn
Mechanical ventilation in severe asthma requires strategies to avoid ventilator-related complications and excessive hyperinflation

pipelineDrugs.name: Dupilumab
pipelineDrugs.mechanism: Monoclonal antibody to IL-4 receptor alpha subunit

excludedAgents.name: Nebulized magnesium sulfate
excludedAgents.reason: Meta-analysis of 10 RCTs showed no efficacy as second-line treatment for acute asthma in children

excludedAgents.name: Ipratropium
excludedAgents.reason: Randomized pilot trial found no clinical benefit versus placebo in children with critical asthma

excludedAgents.name: Propranolol
excludedAgents.reason: Double-blind crossover trial showed no improvement in methacholine challenge when added to inhaled corticosteroids

excludedAgents.name: Montelukast
excludedAgents.reason: Randomized double-blind trial found no effectiveness in controlling asthma attacks in children

excludedAgents.name: Synbiotics (Kidilact)
excludedAgents.reason: Double-blind randomized trial showed no efficacy in treatment of mild to moderate asthma in children
